sloka: दुःखमेवम्विधम् प्राप्तम् पुराकृतमिवाशुभम् ।चिरम् खलु मया पापे त्वम् पापेनाभिरक्षिता ॥२-१२-८०॥
transliteration: duḥkhamevamvidham prāptam purākṛtamivāśubham ।ciram khalu mayā pāpe tvam pāpenābhirakṣitā ॥2-12-80॥

translations.english: O wretch I protected you in my folly for a long time through ignorance, like a rope preserved which turned out to be a noose to hang me with.
